intro: Describe your project in a few sentences. We reply by call, WhatsApp or email. You do not need a finished brief.

lines.heading: Direct lines
lines.replyTime: We reply within 24 hours on business days.

letter.heading: Your inquiry
letter.recipientNote: your message comes straight to us
letter.replyHint: Your phone number and email address. We reply by call, WhatsApp or email.
letter.planMessage: I'd like to start the {plan} maintenance plan, billed {billing, select, annual {yearly} other {monthly}}.
letter.messagePlaceholder: What are you building or fixing, what exists today, and is there a deadline or a decision you need to make?
letter.privacy: We use these details only to reply to this inquiry.
letter.errorFix: Check the marked lines, then send again.
letter.requiredNote: Every field is required except the service.
letter.errorField: Check this field, then send again.

steps.read: We read your message and check it against what we build.
steps.reply: We reply by call, WhatsApp or email, using the details you gave.
steps.call: If the project fits what we build, we suggest the 30-minute initial project consultation call. If it does not, we say so, and why.
steps.after: After the call, we recommend one next step: a technical audit, a written proposal, a project estimate, or a decision not to build yet.

guide.title: What to include in your message

include.what: What you are building or fixing, and who it is for.
include.today: What exists today: a link to the current site or system, if there is one.
include.users: The languages it has to work in, right-to-left included.
include.deadline: Any deadline, launch date or decision the project is tied to.

guide.includeNote: A few lines are enough. If something is not decided yet, say so; that is useful too.
